title.value: Data-access performance anti-patterns in data-intensive systems
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper on performance issues related to data access in data-intensive systems.
title.quote: Data-access performance anti-patterns in data-intensive systems

extractions.description: The paper identifies, categorizes, and validates data access performance issues in NoSQL-based and polyglot persistence data-intensive systems. It targets performance anti-patterns affecting data access, creating a taxonomy of such issues and gauging developer perception of their relevance through empirical research.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily addresses technical aspects of software development and does not focus on climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Data-access is a critical component of data-intensive systems as it determines the overall performance and functionality of such systems.

primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper is on performance issues in data systems and not on any direct or indirect impact on sustainable development goals.
primary_category.quote: Objective: Identify, categorize, and validate data access performance issues in the context of NoSQL-based and polyglot persistence data-intensive systems using qualitative study.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no evident secondary themes related to sustainable development as the paper is technical in nature.
